topic: Automate Video Production with Muapi Director
music: modern high-tech synth beat, steady electronic rhythm, ambient background, instrumental

beats.narration: Tired of editing videos manually? Automate them completely with Muapi Director.

shots.scene: a retro typewriter with paper feed showing the words 'VIDEO AUTO', mixed media paper collage layout, bold colors
shots.element_motion: the paper rises slightly from the typewriter, background halftone dots grow in size
shots.keyframe_prompt: Clean modern flat 2D illustrated collage in the Vox explainer motion-graphic style: bold flat-color vector-illustration cut-outs, simple confident shapes, a limited contemporary palette, crisp infographic editorial layout. Palette: two-color + one red accent, lots of white. Clearly layered hand-cut paper cut-outs with visible torn and scissor-cut edges, tape corners and soft real paper drop shadows, on a bold flat bold pure red cardboard paper background. Halftone print dots, newspaper-clipping scraps, paper-stencil shapes, aged paper texture, slight print misregistration, scattered geometric paper accents. Figures are printed/illustrated cut-outs, NOT CGI, NOT a 3D render — keep print grain and paper imperfections. High-contrast, tactile. Print finish: clean flat, very subtle grain. SCENE (as layered paper cut-outs): a retro typewriter with paper feed showing the words 'VIDEO AUTO', mixed media paper collage layout, bold colors. Include a torn-paper banner with a big bold cut-out English headline 'VIDEO AUTO' in Helvetica/Akzidenz grotesque, tight caps and a small paper sticker accent. Keep the headline crisp and legible.
shots.clip_prompt:
Animate this still into a mixed-media paper-collage MOTION GRAPHIC, printed cut-outs, not photoreal.
CAMERA (one move only): one very slow smooth push-in (uniform scale-up, Ken-Burns).
ELEMENT MOTION (rich — this is the energy, lively, energetic amplitude with clear, bold movement): the paper rises slightly from the typewriter, background halftone dots grow in size. Elements move as paper cut-outs (slide, flap, hinge, pop, scatter, fly).
AESTHETIC: keep the torn-paper, tape, halftone, newsprint and paper-stencil textures and the bold flat background.
FEEL: clean, modern, striking.
COLOR: bold pure red cardboard.
CONSTRAINTS: Keep the HEADLINE TEXT sharp, legible and stable — do not warp or wobble the lettering. Keep the layout stable. Stay flat 2D — no 3D rotation, no perspective change, camera parallel to the poster. ONE continuous move that does not loop, retract or reset. Rigid paper — no morph/melt. Animate the motion only; don't re-render the picture.
